name: Perseo 27 oz. Tritan(TM) Water Bottle
description: Always stay hydrated on game day with this durable and trendy water bottle! This 27 oz. water bottle is BPA-free and comes in an assortment of eye-catching accent colors to choose from. It is designed with a smoky body, matching color band, and a ribbed grip area for a comfortable and secure hold. It is also equipped with a flip drinking spout with a straw and a carrying handle. These are great for handing out on game days, sporting events, company picnics, trade shows, and other promotional events. Add a team, school, or business logo, message, or slogan. Stay hydrated at you next event with this awesome water bottle!
